direction.ceoQuote: Our ambition is to make Africa Energy a key pillar of the Guinean energy sector. Every delivery is a commitment to the development of our country. Quality, rigor and ethics guide each of our operations.
direction.ceoCite: Jean Baptiste HABA, Chief Executive Officer
direction.visionText1: With solid experience in the petroleum sector and deep knowledge of the Guinean market, Jean Baptiste HABA founded Africa Energy SAU with a conviction: Africa needs reliable, transparent and long-term committed energy players.
direction.visionText2: His strategy rests on three pillars: service quality, regulatory compliance and local development. Under his leadership, Africa Energy SAU has built strategic partnerships with SONAP, SGP and DGI.
